page_title: ATM 2-0 OVI | Atletico Madrid v Oviedo 29/11/2025, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+4' The referee checks his watch and blows his whistle to signal the end of this match.
90' 3 additional min. will be played.

89' Giuliano Simeone (Atl. Madrid) does well to control a poor pass on the edge of the box then shoots towards the middle of the goal. Aaron Escandell is out of position but leaps to make a brilliant save.
87' A substitution has been made. Nicolas Gonzalez is replaced by Jose Maria Gimenez (Atl. Madrid).
86' Giuliano Simeone (Atl. Madrid) goes on a mazy run through the defence and gets within shooting range inside the box, but his effort to the middle of the target is thwarted by Aaron Escandell.
85' The linesman signals that Luka Ilic (Real Oviedo) is offside and the referee confirms the decision.
84' A lofted pass finds Conor Gallagher (Atl. Madrid) free in the box, but his first-time effort sails high over the bar. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Oviedo.
82' Luis Carrion has decided to make a change. Luka Ilic (Real Oviedo) replaces Haissem Hassan.
82' The referee signals a substitution. Alberto Reina (Real Oviedo) is brought on as a substitute for Santiago Colombatto.
82' Haissem Hassan (Real Oviedo) looks to break free, but his touch lets him down and he loses the ball.
80' Conor Gallagher (Atl. Madrid) tries to slide the ball through to a teammate but it's well blocked by a defender. The ball is behind the touchline and Atl. Madrid will take a throw-in.
80' Atl. Madrid are playing excellent possession football at the moment by exchanging some long passes.
77' Julian Alvarez (Atl. Madrid) races towards goal but the defender gets back well to make a challenge.
77' Giacomo Raspadori (Atl. Madrid) performs a sliding tackle but catches his opponent's legs. The referee blows his whistle for an infringement.
75' The game has come to an end for Koke. He has contributed as much as he could today. He will be replaced by the fresh legs of Giacomo Raspadori (Atl. Madrid).
75' Luis Carrion has decided to substitute Santi Cazorla and he is replaced by Oviemuno Ejaria (Real Oviedo).
75' That will be all from Salomon Rondon who is being replaced by the fresh legs of Alex Fores (Real Oviedo).
74' Giuliano Simeone (Atl. Madrid) is offside and the linesman raises his flag.
74' The resulting free kick from Santi Cazorla (Real Oviedo) ends up in the gloves of the keeper.
73' Dangerous play by Julian Alvarez (Atl. Madrid). Victor Garcia blows his whistle for a foul. Oviedo earn a free kick.
72' Federico Vinas (Real Oviedo) makes a driving run into the box but he cannot work any space for a shot. The ball is out of play. Atl. Madrid will have a throw-in.
70' The attendance for today's match is 61305.

69' Long passes, short passes and one-two passes. Oviedo are showcasing great team work by keeping possession and producing pin-point passes from player to player. The opposition's players are finding it very difficult to intercept at the moment.
68' None of the Atl. Madrid players could reach the corner kick as the ball was overhit and goes out of play.
67' The corner kick from Julian Alvarez (Atl. Madrid) is headed out of the penalty area by one of the defenders.

66' Giuliano Simeone (Atl. Madrid) passes the ball from the edge of the box in order to find his teammate, who is in a good scoring position, but the defender blocks the pass and spanks the ball to safety. The ball is out of play and the linesman points at the corner flag. Corner to Atl. Madrid.
65' Nicolas Gonzalez (Atl. Madrid) takes a shot from the edge of the box after a brilliant solo effort. The ball heads towards the left post, but the goalkeeper denies him with a fantastic save.
63' Here is a change. Alexander Sorloth is going off and Diego Simeone gives the last tactical orders to Julian Alvarez (Atl. Madrid).
63' Diego Simeone decides to make a substitution. Antoine Griezmann will be replaced by Pablo Barrios (Atl. Madrid).
62' Atl. Madrid keep the ball well and push forward with purpose, but here comes an interception from the opposition.
61' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and Dani Calvo (Real Oviedo) is coming onto the pitch as David Carmo cannot continue after picking up an injury.
60' The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Atl. Madrid.
60' Santi Cazorla (Real Oviedo) pounces on a bouncing ball on the edge of the box, but sends his volley high over the bar.
59' The ball is behind the sideline. Nacho Vidal (Real Oviedo) takes a throw-in.
57' Alexander Sorloth (Atl. Madrid) gets the ball and drives a shot high over the bar from the edge of the area. The ball goes out of play and Oviedo will have a goal kick.

57' Federico Vinas passes to Salomon Rondon (Real Oviedo), but he produces a wild shot from the edge of the box which goes high over the bar. The ball goes out of play and Atl. Madrid will have a goal kick.
56' Nicolas Gonzalez (Atl. Madrid) deprives his opponent of the ball, but the referee blows his whistle for a foul. He's not happy with the decision!
54' David Carmo (Real Oviedo) was probably a bit loose with his words to Victor Garcia, who decides to show him a yellow.
53' Neat passing move from Oviedo in order to create new attacking opportunities.
51' The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Atl. Madrid.
51' Santi Cazorla sends over an inswinging corner and Federico Vinas (Real Oviedo) gets his head on the ball, but it goes just over the bar.
51' Santi Cazorla (Real Oviedo) takes the corner.
50' An attempted cross from Nacho Vidal (Real Oviedo) is cleared.

48' Santi Cazorla (Real Oviedo) sends the ball into the penalty area from a free kick a few yards outside the box. The cross is good, but the goalkeeper shows himself in a good light as he leaps high to intercept the ball.
48' Clement Lenglet (Atl. Madrid) commits a rough challenge and Victor Garcia blows his whistle for a foul. That's a free kick to Oviedo.
47' Nice passing game by Oviedo. They are increasing their possession with a series of long passes and waiting for the right moment to create an attacking opportunity.
47' Nicolas Gonzalez (Atl. Madrid) sends a long ball across the pitch, but it misses its target.
46' The need to improve in the second half has brought about a change. Alex Baena comes off for Giuliano Simeone (Atl. Madrid).
46' The second half gets underway.
45+3' Victor Garcia has ended the first half by blowing the whistle.
45+1' Nacho Vidal (Real Oviedo) skips past his man but can't keep the ball in play.
45' The fourth official shows 2 min. of added time.
43' The Atl. Madrid players are exchanging some short passes to try and open up the opposition’s defence and hit them swiftly on the break.
42' Antoine Griezmann (Atl. Madrid) is about to take a corner kick.
42' Nicolas Gonzalez (Atl. Madrid) whips a promising cross into the box, but the opposition's defence intercepts the ball. Good work from Atl. Madrid as they win a corner.
40' Alex Baena (Atl. Madrid) is having a lively performance. He is causing problems and wanting the ball at every opportunity.
37' The ball is whipped in from the corner by Santi Cazorla (Real Oviedo), but one of the defenders gets it clear.
37' Haissem Hassan (Real Oviedo) passes the ball into the box but an opposing player clears. Oviedo force a corner. They send men into the box.
35' Oviedo hold the ball and are exchanging some long passes.
33' Alexander Sorloth (Atl. Madrid) tries to send the ball in front of the goal, but the opposition's defence averts the threat.
31' Antoine Griezmann (Atl. Madrid) decides to take a short corner instead of crossing into the box.

31' Antoine Griezmann (Atl. Madrid) attempts to find the head of one of his teammates with a promising cross into the box, but a defender outjumps the attackers and averts the threat. The referee signals a corner kick to Atl. Madrid.
31' Antoine Griezmann (Atl. Madrid) rolls the ball short to a teammate from the corner instead of sending a cross into the box.
30' Nicolas Gonzalez (Atl. Madrid) delivers a low pass into the box which is intercepted. The referee and one of his assistants signal for a corner kick to Atl. Madrid.
26' 2 - 0 Goal! Alexander Sorloth (Atl. Madrid) fires the rebound into the middle of the goal after the ball breaks to him in the box. The score is 2:0.
25' Antoine Griezmann (Atl. Madrid) sends a wonderful cross from the corner kick. However, the defence works perfectly to clear the ball and avert the threat.

25' Nicolas Gonzalez (Atl. Madrid) sends a lofted cross into the penalty area. Unfortunately for him, the opponent's defence deals with his cross comfortably and intercepts it. The linesman makes the right call and Atl. Madrid will have a corner.
23' Alex Baena (Atl. Madrid) tries to find Antoine Griezmann, but he puts too much power on the pass.

21' Antoine Griezmann (Atl. Madrid) sees an unmarked teammate and attempts to send him a low pass. However, one of the defenders reads the game perfectly and averts the danger. It's a throw-in for Atl. Madrid.

20' Alexander Sorloth (Atl. Madrid) superbly wins the ball back and has a go from distance, but sends his effort well wide of the left post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Oviedo.
16' 1 - 0 Goal - 1:0! David Hancko laid the ball off to Alexander Sorloth (Atl. Madrid), who shot from close range into the top of the net, leaving the goalkeeper helpless.
15' The Oviedo players are exchanging some short passes.
14' The ball goes out of play and Oviedo will have a goal kick.
13' Antoine Griezmann (Atl. Madrid) looks like he will be the one to take the corner kick.
13' Nicolas Gonzalez (Atl. Madrid) sends a cross into the box, but the opposition's defence clears the ball to safety. The linesman points to the corner flag, Atl. Madrid are going to take it.

12' A cross by Alex Baena (Atl. Madrid) from the side of the pitch flies into the box, but fails to find its intended target as the aim was poor. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Oviedo.
11' Aaron Escandell pulls off a great save to deny Antoine Griezmann (Atl. Madrid), who makes himself some space inside the box and unleashes a quick shot to the right side of the goal.

8' Salomon Rondon (Real Oviedo) picks up a pass, nutmegs an opponent and goes for glory with an effort from distance. It's a poor effort, however, and goes well wide of the left post. The ball goes out of play and Atl. Madrid will have a goal kick.

7' Alexander Sorloth (Atl. Madrid) produced a promising shot towards the right side of the goal after his wonderful solo run, but Aaron Escandell thwarted him with a fabulous save and the score remains the same.
4' Conor Gallagher (Atl. Madrid) goes on a solo run, but he fails to create a chance as an opposition player blocks him.

3' Leander Dendoncker (Real Oviedo) commits an ugly challenge. The referee sees it and immediately blows his whistle. Atl. Madrid win a free kick and will be able to apply some pressure on the opposition goal.

2' Alexander Sorloth (Atl. Madrid) is obviously not following the Golden Rule: "Treat others as you want to be treated.“ He makes a bad challenge and leaves Victor Garcia with no other option than to blow for a foul.
2' Nicolas Gonzalez (Atl. Madrid) delivers a crossfield pass, but the ball is cut out before it reaches its intended target.

The players are on the pitch and Oviedo will have the kick-off.
